title: Long Term Safety of Biphasic Insulin Aspart 30 in Juveniles With Type 1 Diabetes
brief_summary: This trial is conducted in South Africa. The aim of this trial is to investigate Long term safety of biphasic insulin aspart 30 in juveniles with type 1 diabetes previously treated in trial BIAsp-1240.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Signed informed consent obtained before any trial-related activities according to local requirements. (Trial-related activities are any procedure that would not have been performed during normal management of the subject)
* The subject must have completed the trial BIAsp-1240
